name: autogenous
description: Autogenous Genome Language (AGL) for JavaScript: typed mutation admission, scope authority and hard-gate promotion checks from the Rust control plane, compiled to WebAssembly.
author: rUv <ruv@ruv.net>

scripts.build: cargo build -p autogenous-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir wasm --out-name autogenous_wasm "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-../../target}/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/autogenous_wasm.wasm" && mv wasm/autogenous_wasm.js wasm/autogenous_wasm.cjs
